fields.subject: System Isolation Confirmed
fields.body: MCHD-FAX01 and the IIS export interface (MCHD-INT01, 10.72.14.22) are isolated from the county network and imaging has begun. fields.body: Per your order, MCHD-FAX01 and the IIS export interface (MCHD-INT01: 10.72.14.22) have been isolated from the county network. The forensic team has begun imaging MCHD-INT01. The IIS export will not resume until County IT confirms the system is clean and the Informatics Lead signs off on the data-integrity check. No further data will be sent to KDHE until then.
